target.title: policy: classify doctor fix recommendations
target.body:
## Summary  - add policy doctor fix metadata covering every current policy finding - classify findings as automatic, reviewRequired, manual, validateOnly, or unsupported - attach structured `fixRecommendation` data to emitted policy findings without changing `doctor --fix` - keep attestation payloads stable by leaving recommendation metadata out of `attestedFindings` - add metadata/tests that fail when a policy check id lacks a fix classification  ## Validation  - `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts --reporter=dot` - `pnpm exec oxfmt --check src/flows/health-checks.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts` - `pnpm exec oxlint src/flows/health-checks.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/fix-metadata.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts` - `pnpm tsgo:extensions` - `git diff --check`  Not run to completion:  - `pnpm tsgo:core` is blocked in this local worktree by pre-existing untracked `src/oc-path/` files with unused-symbol errors (`hasWildcard`, `JsonlLine`).  ## Stack  Stacked on #99121 (`policy: cover gateway node commands`). This PR includes `policy/gateway-node-command-denied` in the fix-class coverage, so it should be reviewed after/against #99121 and rebased onto `main` after #99121 lands.## Real behavior proofBehavior or issue addressed:Policy doctor findings expose structured `fixRecommendation` metadata for current policy check ids while attested findings remain stable and recommendation-free.Real environment tested:Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-fork` on the restacked policy series, top head `7aebf26a24` and this PR head `076a5cb222`. This is a source-harness proof; it does not start a packaged OpenClaw binary or make live LLM calls.Exact steps or command run after this patch:1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/policy/src/doctor/metadata.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/register.test.ts extensions/policy/src/doctor/strictness.test.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts --reporter=dot`2. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-sdk-surface-report.test.ts --reporter=dot`3. `pnpm tsgo:extensions`4. `pnpm lint:extensions`5. `git diff --check`
6. `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json`Evidence after fix:The focused policy/core/CLI/tooling Vitest run passed 10 core repair-flow tests, 7 SDK surface tooling tests, 13 policy CLI tests, and 334 policy doctor/doctor-lint tests, including fix metadata coverage and the assertion that `attestedFindings` omit `fixRecommendation`. `tsgo:extensions`, `lint:extensions`, `git diff --check`, and `node --import tsx scripts/check-policy-config-coverage.ts --check --json` all exited 0.Observed result after fix:The policy plugin now has fix-class metadata coverage for every policy finding in this stack, and attestation output remains unchanged.What was not tested:No packaged CLI smoke, live provider run, or live LLM call was run for this source-harness proof.
